name: The riverside

layers.essential_history: [[c:The River Nene flows past Wansford on its way to Peterborough and the Wash. In the legend, this is the river Barnaby floated down on his haycock.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The Nene was once busy with boats carrying goods between the towns along it.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A fisherman says Barnaby really did float past at dawn, snoring on a pile of hay. He couldn't have been in the inn yard.]]

evidence: [[c:Barnaby was floating down the river at dawn, asleep on a haycock.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Carry on along the river bank, then bear left across the water meadows, about 190 metres.]]
